headline: Nyfjäll wins Crona Software Halland Open by one shot
blurb: David Nyfjäll finished at 14 under par to win at Laholms Golfklubb, one shot ahead of Sebastian Petersen. It is his second tour victory of the season.
body:
[David Nyfjäll](/david-nyfjall) won the Crona Software Halland Open at Laholms Golfklubb, finishing at 14 under par. [Sebastian Petersen](/sebastian-petersen) came close at 13 under but could not catch the leader. The win was decided by just one shot.

Three players shared third place at 12 under par: [Jakob Hansson](/jakob-hansson), [Jesper Sandborg](/jesper-sandborg) and [Gustav Andersson](/gustav-andersson). The top of the leaderboard was tight, with only two shots separating first from third.

The second round produced some very low scores. Alexander Lindström shot a 61, the best round of the tournament. [Jacob Björnberg](/jacob-bjornberg) and [Hannes Åkermark](/hannes-akermark) both shot 63 in the same round.

Nyfjäll now has two wins this season after also winning the Finnish Open. He has had several other strong results, including a second place at the NeH Hammarö Open. Out of 156 players in the field, 53 made the cut at 2 under par.
